Consider the ellipse centered at (−2,−3) with horizontal radius 5 and vertical radius 3, as shown above. Which of the following sets of parametric equations, defined for θ∈[0,2π), traverse the ellipse once in the counterclockwise direction starting at the point A(3,−3)?

a
x=25cos⁡θ−3,y=9sin⁡θ−2
b
x=5sin⁡θ−2,y=3cos⁡θ−3
c
x=10sin⁡θ−2,y=6cos⁡θ−3
d
x=5cos⁡θ−2,y=3sin⁡θ−3
e
x=5cos⁡θ−3,y=3sin⁡θ−2
